prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical promotional graphic featuring a waist-up portrait of a young woman holding a digital tablet. She is styled in streetwear (orange bomber jacket, beige beanie). Behind her, massive typography spells 'DESIGN'. To her left, text in English is visible. The aesthetic is urban, grunge, and modern, with a textured overlay resembling scratched film or worn paper. The bottom of the image features orange, smoke-like clouds blending into the dark background. High resolution digital advertisement / composite photo manipulation, portrait or telephoto 85mm equivalent, low natural grain, soft artificial studio key from front-left, subtle rim light on hair, neutral subject light with warm orange glow at bottom, high contrast orange, beige, charcoal, and yellow palette, medium waist-up framing and eye-level viewpoint.
prompt.negative_prompt: clean corporate style, missing tablet, wrong wardrobe, flat background, no grunge texture, illegible DESIGN type, low resolution, watermark, signature
